result.scope_note: The claim involves two verifiable historical durations: (1) from the signing of the U.S. Constitution in Philadelphia on September 17, 1787, to the ratification of the Bill of Rights on December 15, 1791, which is approximately 4 years and 3 months; and (2) from the congressional proposal of the Bill of Rights on September 25, 1789, to its ratification on December 15, 1791, which is approximately 2 years and 3 months. These durations are well-documented and can be compared directly using historical records.
